author: opencode-worker-7
text: Diagnosis progress (worker-7, instrumented run): the relay DOES accept the leaf's announce (AnnouncementAccepted { relayed: true }), but root REJECTS it — root.receive returns RplRejected instead of AnnouncementAccepted { peer.iid == leaf }. So the failure is NOT fixture ordering; it is a root-side admission rejection for the relayed leaf announcement. Root was provisioned_root with MemStorage; the leaf's pubkey was never announced to root directly in this fixture (bootstrap only sent relay's announce). Hypothesis: root's TOFU/announce admission rejects the relayed leaf announce because (a) the leaf is not pinned and the relayed-announce admission path requires prior pinning, or (b) the gradient/route validation in the announce admission requires the relay to know the leaf (which it does — leaf joined via multicast DIO). Next step: trace root's announce admission (RplBorderIngressOutcome/AnnounceRejectReason) for the relayed leaf frame to find the exact reject reason. NOT a fixture-ordering fix — do not weaken the assertion.
